// Use 'take' to view a sample number of records in the table and check the data.
YellowTaxiTable
| take 100


YellowTaxiTable 
|summarize total_trip_count=count() by VendorID

select VendorID,count(*) total_trip_count from YellowTaxiTable group by VendorID


YellowTaxiTable
| summarize TotalTrips = count() by VendorID
| render barchart


YellowTaxiTable
| summarize TotalTrips = countif(toreal(trip_distance) > 10) by passenger_count

YellowTaxiTable
| summarize TotalTrips = countif((trip_distance) > 10) by passenger_count




YellowTaxiTable | take 10

| extend total_amount_calc = fare_amount + tip_amount



YellowTaxiTable
| summarize trips = count() by bin(tpep_pickup_datetime, 1h)

// This query returns the number of ingestions per hour in the given table.
YellowTaxiTable
| summarize IngestionCount = count() by bin(ingestion_time(), 1h)
